reason: Section 58(e): common trust fund participants treat as items of tax preference their share, computed "as if the fund were an individual subject to the minimum tax"; 1978 add-on minimum tax rules.

Adjusted current earnings: "alternative minimum taxable income ... is increased by the adjustment for adjusted current earnings" (75 percent of ACE over pre-adjustment AMTI); corporate AMT, repealed after 2017.

Mostly long-term contract accounting, but para (f) states AMTI rules: "Under section 56(a)(3), a taxpayer subject to the AMT must use the PCM to determine its AMTI"; (f)(1) applies to years from 2021, so individual AMT is current.

"all Internal Revenue Code provisions that apply in determining the regular taxable income ... also apply in determining the alternative minimum taxable income"; effective after 1993; individual AMT still applies.
Limits items of tax preference "for purposes of section 56(a)(1)" for years before 1976; examples compute "10 percent of ... less the minimum tax exemption of $30,000".
Scope: "For purposes of the minimum tax for tax preferences" lists the items of tax preference (excess investment interest, capital gains deduction, etc.); 1969 add-on tax.
Section 58(d): apportions an electing small business corporation's items of tax preference to shareholders and imposes "the minimum tax" on certain capital gains; 1970s add-on regime.

Conduit and partnership rules for items of tax preference "solely for purposes of the minimum tax for tax preferences"; "The minimum tax is effective for taxable years ending after December 31, 1969."
Section 58(g)(2): foreign-source capital gains and stock option preferences are excluded unless the foreign country gives "preferential treatment"; add-on minimum tax preference rules.

Trust and estate itemized deductions that are not "alternative tax itemized deductions (as defined in section 55(e)(1))" become items of tax preference after 1982; this is the pre-1987 individual AMT, whose rules do not govern 2025.
Table of contents for § 1.56-1 (book income adjustment, corporate AMT). It lists headings only and states no rules, so I judged it not operative.

For the section 1374 tax, "The tentative minimum tax described in section 55(b) is determined using the rate of tax applicable to corporations"; also limits the minimum tax credit under 53(c). Uses the $40,000 corporate exemption.
Procedure for TEFRA elections; the list includes "58(i)(1) Optional 10-year write off of certain tax preferences", but the section only sets time and manner of elections.
Outline of headings for §§ 1.904(b)-1/-2, including "alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit" headings; it states no rules.
Table of contents for § 1.56(g)-1 (adjusted current earnings, corporate AMT). It lists headings only and states no rules, so I judged it not operative.

Mostly the section 11(b) additional tax, but para (b) sets the controlled-group "reduction set forth in section 55(d)(3) to the amount exempted from the alternative minimum tax" (the $40,000 corporate exemption).

Net lease elections "for purposes of section 57 (relating to items of tax preference for purposes of the minimum tax for tax preferences)" and 163(d); these decide whether net-leased property generates a preference. 1973.
Consolidated SRLY limit on "separate return year minimum tax credit" using "consolidated section 53(c) limitation" and consolidated tentative minimum tax; written for the pre-2018 corporate AMT.
"The tax imposed by section 56 applies to an organization subject to tax under section 511 with respect to items of tax preference" entering into UBTI; 1978 minimum tax for tax preferences.

Section 59(e) "Optional 10-year writeoff of certain tax preferences": election and revocation rules for ratable deduction, which takes expenditures out of AMT preferences/adjustments; applies from 2004 on.
Elections to pay the optional tax under section 3 / standard deduction; nothing about the minimum tax.
Heading only: "Limitations on certain capital losses and excess credits in computing alternative minimum tax. [Reserved]"; no rules stated.
Section 58(f): RIC/REIT items of tax preference apportioned to shareholders; "The minimum tax exemption of the trust or company shall not be reduced"; 1978 add-on rules.
Defines items of tax preference under 1969 section 57(a)(2)-(9) (accelerated depreciation, stock options, bad debt reserves, capital gains); "subject to tax under section 56(a)".
Section 58(c)(1): items of tax preference of estates and trusts apportioned between trust and beneficiaries; adjustments to "the trust's minimum tax exemption"; 1978 add-on regime.

Section 904(b) applies "for purposes of determining the alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit under section 59", with section 55(b) rates for individuals and corporations; effective after July 2004.

Section 57(d)(2) election, added in 1976, to use cost depletion "for purposes of determining the amount of the preference under section 57(a)(11)" (intangible drilling costs); 1954 Code add-on minimum tax.
Section 58(g)(1): foreign-source items of tax preference count "for purposes of section 56" only to the extent they reduce U.S. tax; suspense preferences; "10 pct" minimum tax examples.
